relay: Run the background relay that starts sessions here.
relay diagnostic: Show one saved native failure capture.
relay install: Install the relay as a background service.
relay probe-models: Check which models this machine's harnesses offer now.
relay probe-surface: Check which harness apps this machine can run.
relay report: Manage relay reports the server rejected.
relay report quarantine: Set aside a relay report the server rejected for good.
relay serve: Run the relay in the foreground until stopped.
relay serve-once: Run one relay pass and exit.
relay status: Show whether the relay service is installed and healthy.
